name: Pretty Cat ~Lily and Kyle no Daibouken~
original_name: ぷりてぃ きゃっと ～リリィとカイルの大冒険～
source:
A mysterious world inhabited only by beast people.

Kyle is beaten and robbed on a road by a group of rat-people. Lily finds him on the road and leads him to her village.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个只有兽人居住的神秘世界。

凯尔在路上被一群鼠人殴打和抢劫。莉莉在路上找到了他，并带他去了她的村庄。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
